description: a stepped turned part revolved a half turn about z — a disc of radius 2 from z 0 to 1, and on it a riser from radius 1 at z 1 to radius top at z 2, a cone at top 0.5 and a cylinder in the variant at top 1 — its profile's plane y = 0 the end face; the end face's top edge at x 1..2 filleted at r 0.3: a convex blend running into a step whose face across is the riser, a mixed corner (the end face's ruling of the riser convex, the riser's foot concave). The trim on the ruling lies past the vertex on its line continued down the end face, and the ruling is lengthened to it; the foot circle is cut; the riser takes the end, the quartic of the blend's cylinder with it, traced and fitted (ADR-0037, ADR-0038). The far end on the disc's side cylinder is a convex corner, traced too. No closed form for the volume: the oracle's

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE keeps the consumed corner vertex on the lengthened ruling, two edges of one line between the same two faces; Arris lengthens the one edge to the trim (ADR-0038)
